exposure: mode of delivery (water immersion vs. conventional)
cohort: The study included 2749 primiparous women who had a vaginal delivery, 600 in the water immersion group and 2149 in the conventional delivery group.
finding: While water immersion delivery was associated with a lower episiotomy rate, it did not significantly reduce the rates of pelvic floor disorders compared to conventional delivery.
mod_finding: Water immersion delivery was associated with a lower rate of episiotomy, which is beneficial for maintaining pelvic floor muscle strength postpartum.
